notes: Hardware-only paper: no accuracy, no training details. Iris (16 Boolean features, 12 clauses, 3 classes) is used for functional verification (correct predictions on a short sequence, target classes 2,0,1,1). Table IV does not restate the configuration; Eq. 3 (throughput = 2FCK f_infer) with F=16, C=12, K=3 is consistent with the Iris setup, which is the only configuration described. Whether the 12 multi-class TM clauses are per class or total is not stated (Eq. 1 uses n clauses per class with n/2 per polarity), so clauses_scope is not_reported for the multi-class groups. Table III lists 3329 TOP/J for the proposed multi-class TM while Table IV and the record use 3290.00 (paper inconsistency, already noted in the record). Sec. III-B percentages (e.g. +247% energy efficiency vs sync) are derived from Table IV. Proposed designs are mixed-signal simulations; baselines are post-implementation digital, so the comparison mixes evaluation levels. Clause weight bit width and e (fine-delay bits) are not given; Fig. 6 waveforms suggest 3-bit k/fine fields (class0_pk<2:0>) but this is figure-only.
